description: Python (uv) projects: weekly uv toolchain group, weekly automerged dependency-groups

packageRules.description: [disable] requires-python is managed by hand together with the CI test matrix
[automerge] Merge dependency-groups (test, dev, docs) bumps once CI passes
[group] Batch all uv related changes into one weekly PR (Saturday and Sunday night)
[schedule] Propose dependency-groups (test, dev, docs) bumps weekly (Saturday and Sunday night)
